RULE.description:
The rule that produced the covariance. In a CCSDS covariance block,
Operator keeps the operator's COV_BASIS, ScaledFit is DETERMINED, and
SourceModel, PooledModel and EmpiricalHistoryShrunk are EMPIRICAL with
MODEL_ID as COV_BASIS_ID.

MODEL_ID.description:
Identifier of the error model (SourceModel, PooledModel) or of the
measured realism factor (ScaledFit) the covariance came from. Empty for
Operator. For EmpiricalHistoryShrunk, identifies the population prior;
EVIDENCE identifies the history estimator and its configuration.

REGIME.description: Orbit regime of the cell, as the model names it.

AGE_DAYS.description:
Age of the element set at the covariance's epoch, in days. NaN when the
covariance is not an element set's.

HORIZON_DAYS.description:
Prediction horizon of the cell, in days: the element-set age its
statistics were measured at. NaN when no cell applies.

MEASURED_LINEAGE.description:
Lineage of the reference data the cell was measured on (a PVN LINEAGE).
The test speaks for a covariance whose source has this lineage; for any
other lineage the numbers are the cell's, and CALIBRATION is Uncalibrated.

TEST_WINDOW.description:
Window of the held-out reference states the test used: an ISO 8601 UTC
interval, start/end.

MEAN_D2_OVER_3.description: Mean of d2/3 over the held-out samples. NaN when not measured.

COVERAGE_95.description:
Share of the held-out samples inside the 95 % region, 0 to 1. NaN when
not measured.

SAMPLES.description: Number of held-out samples the test used.

OBJECTS.description: Number of distinct objects the samples came from.

SCALE_FACTOR.description:
Factor the covariance was multiplied by to make it realistic. NaN when
none was applied.

CALIBRATION.description:
The verdict. Calibrated when MEAN_D2_OVER_3 lies in [0.8, 1.25] and
COVERAGE_95 in [0.93, 0.97], from at least 30 samples of at least 3
objects of MEASURED_LINEAGE; Uncalibrated otherwise, including a cell
never measured.

EVIDENCE.description: Identifier of the report or record that holds the test.

HISTORY_SAMPLES.description:
Number of retained older/newer element-set residual pairs from this
object in the age bin containing AGE_DAYS, after rejection/clipping.
Zero means no retained pairs; never the held-out test count SAMPLES.

HISTORY_SETS.description:
Number of distinct older element sets contributing HISTORY_SAMPLES.
Zero means none; never the distinct calibration-object count OBJECTS.

HISTORY_WINDOW.description:
ISO 8601 UTC start/end interval spanning the element-set epochs used
in the object's history fit. Empty when no history was used. This is
training support, not TEST_WINDOW or the element-set age AGE_DAYS.

SHRINKAGE_WEIGHT.description:
Dimensionless population-prior fraction alpha in the covariance blend
P = (1-alpha) H + alpha P_prior, where H is the history error second
moment and P_prior includes the population model's realism scaling.
Range [0,1]: 0 is all history, 1 is all prior; NaN when not applicable
or unknown. For interpolation across bins, report the correspondingly
interpolated alpha. EVIDENCE must identify the estimator/configuration,
retained-count bin, participating bins and their weights so the blend
can be reconstructed; the scalar alone does not describe that mixture.
This is not SCALE_FACTOR, which multiplies a covariance. History-only
evidence leaves CALIBRATION Uncalibrated and test statistics unmeasured.

TRUTH_EPOCHS.description:
Distinct truth epochs among the SAMPLES: predictions that share one truth
state count once here. 0 when not stated.

COVERAGE_1_SIGMA_AXIS1.description:
Share of the held-out samples whose error lies inside the 1-sigma band of
the first, second and third axis of the covariance's frame (radial,
in-track and cross-track for an RTN or curvilinear covariance), 0 to 1;
nominal 0.6827 for Gaussian errors. NaN when not measured.

COVERAGE_3_SIGMA_AXIS1.description: As COVERAGE_1_SIGMA_AXISn for the 3-sigma band; nominal 0.9973.

MPETargeterConstraint.description:
One constraint in a maneuver-targeting problem and how well the converged
solution satisfies it.

FRAME.description: Reference frame the constraint is expressed in

EPOCH.description:
Epoch the constraint applies at (UNIX timestamp) [numeric seconds since
1970-01-01T00:00:00 UTC]; 0 when the constraint anchors to EVENT

EVENT.description: Event the constraint anchors to when EPOCH is 0, e.g. "APOAPSIS"

TARGET_VALUE.description: Target value of the constrained quantity

ACHIEVED_VALUE.description: Value achieved by the converged solution

TOLERANCE.description: Acceptable tolerance on the constrained quantity

WEIGHT.description: Relative weight of this constraint in the corrector

MPETargeterSolution.description:
Maneuver-targeter solution and convergence metadata carried with an
extended MPE: the solver that produced the targeted element set, its
iteration/residual history, and the constraint set it satisfied.

DYNAMICS.description: Dynamics contract the solution was targeted under: SGP4, FFM, CR3BP

CONVERGED.description: Whether the corrector converged within tolerance

RESIDUAL_RMS.description: RMS of the final-iteration constraint residuals

RESIDUALS.description: Final-iteration residual per constraint, aligned with CONSTRAINTS

CONSTRAINTS.description: The constraint set the solution was targeted against

TOTAL_DELTA_V.description: Total delta-v of the solved maneuver sequence in m/s

SOLVED_AT.description: Unix ms the solution was produced

ENTITY_ID.description: Unique ID as a String [no units]

EPOCH.description: Epoch of Mean Keplerian elements (UNIX timestamp) [numeric seconds since 1970-01-01T00:00:00 UTC]

MEAN_MOTION.description: Mean motion in rev/day [M if chosen to represent orbit size for SGP/SGP4 elements]

RA_OF_ASC_NODE.description: Right ascension of ascending node in degrees

BSTAR.description: SGP/SGP4 drag-like coefficient (BSTAR) in units of 1/[Earth radii]

MEAN_ELEMENT_THEORY.description: Description of the Mean Element Theory (SGP4, DSST, USM)

TARGETER.description:
Targeter solution + convergence metadata when this element set is the
product of maneuver targeting (absent for ordinary element sets)

BTERM.description:
BTERM, the SGP4-XP drag term Cd*A/m in m**2/kg ($OMM BTERM). An SGP4XP set (MEAN_ELEMENT_THEORY
SGP4XP) carries BTERM and AGOM and leaves BSTAR 0; 0 for SGP4.

AGOM.description: AGOM, the SGP4-XP radiation term gamma*A/m in m**2/kg ($OMM AGOM). SGP4XP only; 0 for SGP4.

MORCovariancePropagation.description:
What propagates COVARIANCE_DATA beyond its epoch: the values of $OCM OCMCovariancePropagation, same
names, units and meanings, all thirteen always present.

MORWindow.description:
One window of the polynomial rows derived from this record's elements: Chebyshev series of the first
kind over [EPOCH_MID_SECONDS - EPOCH_HALF_SPAN, EPOCH_MID_SECONDS + EPOCH_HALF_SPAN], position in km and
velocity in km/s, TEME of date, about the Earth.

EPOCH_MID_SECONDS.description: Middle of the window, seconds after EPOCH_UNIX_US.

STATUS.description: SERVED, or why no record serves the window.

POS_COEFF_COUNT.description: Position coefficients per axis, 1 or more when SERVED; the last triple is not +0.0 on all three axes.

POS_COEFF_HEAD_COUNT.description:
Leading position coefficients per axis held as binary64; the rest are binary32. At most
POS_COEFF_COUNT.

VEL_COEFF_COUNT.description:
Velocity coefficients per axis; 0 for a position-only window. The last triple is not +0.0 on all
three axes.

VEL_COEFF_HEAD_COUNT.description: Leading velocity coefficients per axis held as binary64. At most VEL_COEFF_COUNT.

NORAD_CAT_ID.description: The object's NORAD catalog number, the join key to $CAT, $OMM and $OCM; 0 when it has none.

ORIGINATOR.description:
Who issued the set ($OCM HEADER.ORIGINATOR). A reader keys a series on NORAD_CAT_ID,
INTERNATIONAL_DESIGNATOR and ORIGINATOR.

OBJECT_NAME.description: The object's name; absent unless a reader copies it into what it writes.

MESSAGE_STATUS.description: Whether the set is real or test data.

EPOCH_UNIX_US.description:
Epoch of the elements: microseconds since 1970-01-01T00:00:00 UTC, every UTC day 86,400,000,000
(the UNIX time scale of $MPE EPOCH). An $OCM EPOCH text with up to six fraction digits converts both
ways without loss; an instant inside a leap second has no value here.

MEAN_ELEMENT_THEORY.description: The theory the set is defined under: SGP4, SGP4XP or AP. A reader refuses UNSPECIFIED.

MEAN_MOTION.description: Mean motion, rev/day, as the theory defines it: Kozai for SGP4, Brouwer for SGP4XP and AP.

RA_OF_ASC_NODE.description: Right ascension of the ascending node, deg.

BTERM.description: Drag term Cd*A/m, m**2/kg. SGP4XP and AP; 0 for SGP4.

AGOM.description: Radiation term Cr*A/m, m**2/kg. SGP4XP and AP; 0 for SGP4.

GRAVITY_FIELD.description: The gravity field the set flies on.

MAXIMUM_TESSERAL_DEGREE.description: Highest tesseral degree of the field's terms; 0 for SGP4 and SGP4XP.

MAXIMUM_ZONAL_DEGREE.description: Highest zonal degree of the field's terms; 0 for SGP4 and SGP4XP.

SOLID_TIDES_MODEL.description: The solid Earth tide the set flies with.

SOLAR_RAD_PRESSURE.description: The radiation pressure model the set states.

OD_PARAMETERS.description:
The dynamic parameters the orbit determination carried, bit k for prwDynamicParameter ordinal k:
DRAG_AREA_OVER_MASS (bit 1, value BTERM), SRP_AREA_OVER_MASS (bit 3, value AGOM) and ECOM2_Y0
(bit 6, value ECOM2_Y0). Any other bit has no value here and is refused.

OD_SOLVED_FOR.description: Of OD_PARAMETERS, the ones the orbit determination solved for (the others were held).

ECOM2_Y0.description: The ECOM2 Y0 radiation acceleration, m/s**2, when OD_PARAMETERS has bit 6.

ACTUAL_OD_SPAN.description: The span of the observations the orbit determination used, days; NaN when not stated.

COVARIANCE_DATA.description:
The epoch covariance, lower triangle row by row, N(N+1)/2 values: N = 6 plus the solved parameters
among DRAG_AREA_OVER_MASS, DRAG_AREA_OVER_MASS_RATE, SRP_AREA_OVER_MASS, IN_TRACK_ACCELERATION and
OUTGASSING_ACCELERATION; position and velocity in km and km/s in TRAJ_REF_FRAME of the expansion,
then those parameters in ascending ordinal. Absent: no covariance.

COV_PROPAGATION.description: What propagates COVARIANCE_DATA beyond its epoch; with COVARIANCE_DATA only.

COV_REALISM.description: The realism of COVARIANCE_DATA, the single entry of $OCM COV_REALISM.

COV_CALIBRATION.description: Whether COVARIANCE_DATA's coverage was measured against independent reference states.

COV_CALIBRATION_REFERENCE.description: Identifier of that calibration evidence (a report or record).

WINDOWS.description:
Polynomial rows derived from this record by the builder its asset names ($DPM DPMAsset.DERIVED_BUILD),
in time order, without overlap. A convenience: the elements remain authoritative, a reader may ignore
the rows, and one that cannot reproduce the asset's build statement must.

WINDOW_COEFF_HEADS.description:
The binary64 coefficients of the served windows, in window order: for each, X, Y and Z of position
(POS_COEFF_HEAD_COUNT each), then X, Y and Z of velocity (VEL_COEFF_HEAD_COUNT each).

WINDOW_COEFF_TAILS.description:
The binary32 coefficients of the served windows, in the same order: X, Y and Z of position
(POS_COEFF_COUNT - POS_COEFF_HEAD_COUNT each), then of velocity.

FALLBACK.description:
The object's own element set for times beyond what this record serves (a reader's fallback
propagator), as an $MPE: SGP4 with BSTAR or SGP4XP with BTERM and AGOM. Its ENTITY_ID is absent: the
object is this record's.
